camel_example: aliyun sas CreateOssScanConfig --region cn-hangzhou --AutoAdd 0 --KeySuffixList.1 '.asp' --BucketNameList.1 'cccarvato-oss0000' --ScanDayList.1 1 --EndTime '01:01:00' --StartTime '00:00:00' --DecompressMaxFileCount 100 --RealTimeIncr true --DecompressMaxLayer 1 --Source OSS --Name testName --AllKeyPrefix true --DecryptionList.1 KMS --KeyPrefixList.1 '/root' --LastModifiedStartTime 1724301769834 --Enable 1 --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
description_en: Creates a scan policy for detecting malicious files in OSS under the malicious file detection feature
description_zh: 恶意文件检测功能下，创建对OSS内恶意文件检测的策略配置
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-oss-scan-config --enable 1 --scan-day-list 1 --bucket-name-list cccarvato-oss0000 --key-suffix-list .asp --start-time 00:00:00 --end-time 01:01:00 --name testName --key-prefix-list /root --all-key-prefix true --decompress-max-layer 1 --decompress-max-file-count 100 --decryption-list KMS --last-modified-start-time 1724301769834 --real-time-incr true --auto-add 0 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOssScanConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the policy. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The scan schedule. The number represents the day of the week
parameters.help_zh: 扫描时间，数字表示一周中的第几天
parameters.name: scan_day_list

parameters.help_en: The list of file suffixes to scan
parameters.name: key_suffix_list

parameters.help_en: The scan start time, in the HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The scan stop time, in the HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to match all prefixes. If this parameter is set to true, the KeyPrefixList parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 是否匹配所有前缀。此参数设置为true时，参数KeyPrefixList不生效
parameters.name: all_key_prefix

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of decompression layers when multiple levels of nested compressed files exist. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 5. When the maximum number of decompression layers is exceeded, the decompression operation stops. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected
parameters.help_zh: 存在多个层级的压缩包嵌套时的最大解压层数，最小取值为1，最大取值为5。超过最大解压层数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响
parameters.name: decompress_max_layer

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of files to decompress. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 1000. When the maximum number of decompressed files is exceeded, the decompression operation stops. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected
parameters.help_zh: 最大解压文件数。最小取值为1，最大取值为1000。超过最大解压文件数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响
parameters.name: decompress_max_file_count

parameters.help_en: Specifies that only files whose last modification time is after the specified timestamp are scanned. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检测最后一次修改时间在指定时间戳之后的文件，单位毫秒
parameters.name: last_modified_start_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable real-time incremental detection. If this parameter is set to true, the ScanDayList, StartTime, and EndTime parameters do not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启实时增量检测。此参数设置为true时，参数ScanDayList、StartTime、EndTime不生效
parameters.name: real_time_incr

parameters.help_en:
The business source. Valid values:
OSS: OSS.
NAS: NAS
parameters.help_zh:
业务来源。取值：
OSS：OSS
NAS：NAS
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether OSS buckets are automatically added to this policy. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
OssBucket是否默认加入此策略
true：开启
false：不开启
parameters.name: auto_add

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
